description: Election Commission - Diddeni Gamage Janka Roshan Pushpakumara was elected as the member of the Ward No. 1 Kiriwandala North of Seethawakapura U.C
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Seethawakapura Urban Council) due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a new member by a political party and the official declaration of the elected member by the Returning Officer. This content is directly related to electoral processes at the local government level, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
